verdict.rationale: Braintrust has an AI agent (Loop) and prompt playgrounds, so letting users plug in MCP servers for tool use is a fair question for this kind of product. The evidence only documents Braintrust's own MCP server, which lets external clients like Claude Code and Cursor call Braintrust. That is the server role and does not show Braintrust consuming third-party MCP servers. No evidence shows Loop, playgrounds or prompts connecting to external MCP servers as tools.
